dedupe_keys.name: ecotransit world freight transport emissions calculator and methodology

description: EcoTransIT World (ETW) is a calculator of the environmental impact of freight transport for any route in the world and any mode, maintained by the EcoTransIT World Initiative, an industry platform of more than 100 carriers, logistics providers and shippers. Its scientific partners are INFRAS (sea, inland and air transport), ifeu (road, rail, cooled transport and energy factors) and Fraunhofer IML (logistics sites), with IVE Hannover responsible for business solutions, routing and GIS data. Coverage: energy use, greenhouse gases and air pollutants for single shipments and whole transport chains by road, rail, sea, inland waterway and air, with an integrated route planner; the 2024 methodology update aligns with ISO 14083, and the tool is accredited against the GLEC Framework. Format and access: a free internet application, plus Business Solutions that calculate large numbers of shipments through an API. Licence and cost: the website calculator is free of charge; business interfaces and updates are covered by licence fees. Caveats: the report notes the calculation is no longer EN 16258 compliant because ISO 14083 conversion factors are applied. It can convert flows from freight network models into emissions for decarbonisation scenarios. It relates to COPERT and HBEFA in the catalogue.
